name: Core lot operational semantics
purpose: Read-only per-lot view of lifecycle and execution state, retained material-hold history and append-only component execution and rework history, with distinct re-entrant route visits.
authority_level: Core domain read; no command, approval, rework execution or physical execution authority
security_classification: Internal manufacturing-domain metadata; no credentials or Oracle labels

semantics.reentrancy: A route may revisit an operation class; every visit keeps its own identity and revision and every execution cites exactly one visit. After STEP_COMPLETED a lot returns to READY for its next visit; lifecycle state does not change per visit.
semantics.hold: Material hold is independent of lifecycle and execution state. At most one hold per lot is ACTIVE; an ACTIVE hold rejects dispatch with ACTIVE_HOLD. Released holds remain as history.
semantics.rework: Rework is an explicit directive-linked segment appended to immutable history. The directive cites a prior origin execution and a return visit on the original route; scrapped material cannot be reworked and completed material needs a governed reopen.
semantics.ordering: Holds are ordered by placement time then identity; component histories by component identity; executions keep append order.
semantics.revision: Revisions are opaque nonblank per-entity strings with no numeric comparison, freshness guarantee or global snapshot.
semantics.scope: This contract does not define route position (core.scheduling-snapshot.v1), protected rework execution, transition commands or world binding.
